matrix.basis: Exact same packet_id+digest returns INPUT_DUPLICATE_IGNORED before final-turn mutation. It does append a new audit event, so byte-identical full reducer state is not idempotent even though semantic admission appears idempotent.
Different packet_id with already-used sequence does not bypass per-turn expected-sequence check; unrecognized replay flag still reaches fail-closed exception.

Older sequence is rejected before _final_turns state could regress. Formal fixture flag spelling differs from implementation's literal 'reorder', but mismatch still raises rather than mutating semantic state.
Unexpected sequence raises unless the exact 'reorder' injection flag is present, in which case an explicit INPUT_REORDER_REJECTED event is emitted.
cancel_for_barge_in mutates output playback only. emit_intent accepts arbitrary tool_ref after cancellation and contains no epoch/generation/request ownership admission check.

Queued cancel preserves heard_fraction=0 and commit_eligible=false, but close_session can later create VoiceOutcome from externally supplied result_ref/result_sha256 without proving relation to committed/heard output.
Barge-in preserves partial heard_fraction and revokes commit_eligible. No adapter-level constraint prevents a later VoiceOutcome result from representing the full generated segment.
No snapshot/restore/restart/reconnect state contract or cancellation tombstone restore path is present in the reviewed file.
A new cortex instance rejects packet.session_id mismatch, but there is no explicit epoch model for same-session reopen semantics.
VoicePacketCortex binds one VoiceSessionCapsule/session_id and rejects foreign-session input packets.
Corrupt packet raises before semantic event/tool/memory admission, but _input_seen is mutated before corruption validation, poisoning later corrected retry semantics for that packet_id.
monotonic_ms is individually nonnegative but accept_input does not compare it with prior packet/event monotonic time. An increasing sequence with decreasing timestamp is source-admissible.
emit_intent accepts memory_refs/tool_ref as metadata without request generation or cancellation ownership checks, so old-turn completion isolation is not enforced in this adapter.
close_session sets is_open=false; later accept_input rejects closed session.

additional_owner_handoff_gap.basis: _input_seen, _last_input_sequence, _final_turns, _outputs and _events have no observed compaction or retention bound in the reviewed module.
